queries.sql: SELECT account_code, account_name, account_type, statement_section, is_leaf, sign_convention, sort_order FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_active = TRUE
SELECT calc_id, account_code, expression, calc_version, rationale, updated_by, updated_at FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_CALC_DEFINITION WHERE is_active = TRUE

WITH p AS (
                         SELECT VERSION_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, PERIOD, SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMT, MODE(INPUT_METHOD) AS METHOD, COUNT(*) AS N
                         FROM (SELECT VERSION_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, DIM_PRIMARY, DIM_SECONDARY, DIM_TERTIARY, DIM_QUATERNARY, DIM_5, PERIOD, AMOUNT, INPUT_METHOD FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.VERSION_ID, a.ACCOUNT_CODE, a.DIM_PRIMARY, a.DIM_SECONDARY, a.DIM_TERTIARY, a.DIM_QUATERNARY, a.DIM_5, a.PERIOD, a.AMOUNT, a.INPUT_METHOD
  FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY a JOIN (SELECT VERSION_ID, MIN(PERIOD) AS FIRST_FC FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY WHERE VERSION_ID NOT IN (1, 2) GROUP BY VERSION_ID) f
    ON a.VERSION_ID = 1 AND a.PERIOD < f.FIRST_FC AND LEFT(a.PERIOD, 4) = LEFT(f.FIRST_FC, 4)) WHERE LEFT(PERIOD, 4) = '2026' GROUP BY VERSION_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, PERIOD)
                       SELECT p.VERSION_ID, p.ACCOUNT_CODE,
                              -- balances are stocks: closing period; opening cash: first period; flows: sum
                              CASE WHEN ANY_VALUE(a.ACCOUNT_TYPE) = 'BS' THEN MAX_BY(p.AMT, p.PERIOD)
                                   WHEN p.ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('cf-beg-cash') THEN MIN_BY(p.AMT, p.PERIOD)
                                   ELSE SUM(p.AMT) END AS TOTAL,
                              MODE(p.METHOD) AS METHOD, SUM(p.N) AS N
                       FROM p LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.ACCOUNT_CODE = p.ACCOUNT_CODE
                       GROUP BY p.VERSION_ID, p.ACCOUNT_CODE
SELECT account_code, depends_on FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_CALC_DEFINITION WHERE is_active = TRUE
